parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language that is used to return the description of the system policy. Valid values:

*   en: English
*   zh-CN: Chinese.
*   ja: Japanese

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-plugin-templates --plugin-name jwtAuth --biz-language zh --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribePluginTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --PluginName jwtAuth --Language zh
